name: Oszlár (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Oszlár (a crowned red shield with a white fish and a fleur-de-lis, between green branches) above the name OSZLÁR in grey.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Oszlár arms with crown and branches
